On Thu, May 20, 2027 at 09:22 AM PDT stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai wrote:
> Folks — forwarding an active customer P0. MediQ is showing a fast-rising 5xx + latency event in us-west2. They asked specifically for an immediate cross-region diversion to us-east1.

Quick update / proposed actions (technical):
1) Validate routing capacity in us-east1 (baseline checked: we have ~45% spare capacity on the dedicated pools that would serve MediQ's profile).
2) Enable transparent geo-failover for MediQ's route with a gradual 10% -> 50% -> 100% steering over 6 minutes to avoid amplification.
3) Switch model routing to the compatible quantized variant (v3-quant-compat) in us-east1 — expected p95 increase ~80-120ms; token cost delta negligible.
4) Keep prefix/KV cache warm by pre-warming with a small set of live traffic (we'll seed with 3 synthetic requests).
5) If we observe >3% error increase after failover, rollback to us-west2 and switch to canary debug mode.

ETA: if approved, we can initiate the first 10% shift in ~8 minutes (9:46 PDT) and full shift in ~20 minutes. I'll be on the bridge and will post live traces to the incident doc.

Risks: transient elevated latency during cache warm-up; minor model perf delta noted above.

Jonas Weber
Sr. Reliability Engineer — Redwood Inference
